steps.en: AN notices needing a letter are selected
steps.id: Notice AN yang perlu surat dipilih

steps.en: Only notices with an address enter the letter
steps.id: Hanya notice beralamat yang masuk surat

steps.en: The AN letter is produced as a PDF
steps.id: Surat AN dibuat dalam bentuk PDF
steps.why_en: The letter template lives in the database and a failed PDF is only logged.
steps.why_id: Template surat ada di database dan PDF yang gagal hanya dicatat.

steps.en: The AN letter is produced as a data file
steps.id: Surat AN dibuat dalam bentuk data file

steps.en: The data file is sent to the vendor
steps.why_en: Uploads to the print vendor are blocked in the repo settings.
steps.why_id: Upload ke vendor cetak diblokir di pengaturan repo.

steps.en: The letter PDFs reach the vendor
steps.why_en: The PDFs are only stored in cloud storage; no send step to the vendor exists.
steps.why_id: PDF hanya disimpan di penyimpanan cloud; tidak ada langkah kirim ke vendor.

steps.en: After sending, the notice is recorded as letter sent
steps.id: Setelah dikirim, notice dicatat sudah dikirim surat
steps.why_en: The notice is marked as sent even when blocked uploads mean nothing reached the vendor.
steps.why_id: Notice tetap ditandai terkirim walau upload diblokir dan tidak ada yang sampai ke vendor.
